verdict.rationale: IP India's own navigation exposes 'Track Application Status' / 'Track Status' entries for patents, designs, trademarks and GIs. The patents e-services page links Track Status to the public application-status search on iprsearch.ipindia.gov.in with no account named, and hearing cause lists, dynamic cause lists and Controller's decisions are also published for case-level visibility. Missing for 10: documentation of what status details and fields the lookup returns, hands-on or independent confirmation that the public search works without login across all IP types.
